scope: All 72 retained 640x360 source samples per host. Each sequence starts with a VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest on frame 0 and recursively applies VNTrackObjectRequest to the prior tracker observation. IoU is evaluated against the frozen authored zone.

recipe.sourceDownscale: native 1920x1080 PNG decoded then rectangle mapped to 640x360

reason: The tracker predicts a rectangle from a prior observation and can carry a face box through the hand/pose occlusion. That closes the frozen oracle in this fixture, but it is a temporal prediction rather than an independently observed face rectangle; promoting it to face observations would erase the required occlusion/error gap and allow a crop to rely on an unobserved head. A sequence-level tracked subject mode needs an explicit contract and separate status before it can replace observation-local rectangles.
